dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よぉし、行くのだ！」
dialogues.en: "Okay, let's go!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, let's go!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃぁ〜、いいのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Is it okay?"
dialogues.text: "Is it okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「構わん。既成事実さえ作ってしまえば、こち
　らのものだ」
dialogues.en: "No problem."
dialogues.text: "No problem."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「嬉しいけど……でもさぁ、やっぱり接吻も結
　婚してからくらいなのが大和撫子じゃないか
　な？」
dialogues.en:
"That's nice, but shouldn't I save my first kiss for until I
get married?"
dialogues.text:
"That's nice, but shouldn't I save my first kiss for until I
get married?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「現代の環境でそのような古きしきたりは、す
　でに意味を失っている！」
dialogues.en: "What century are you from?"
dialogues.text: "What century are you from?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「伝統は大事だと思うけど？」
dialogues.en: "I think we should take tradition more seriously."
dialogues.text: "I think we should take tradition more seriously."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「しかし、事は一刻を争う以上、伝統も弁当も
　あるまい」
dialogues.en:
"But since we're in a hurry, there's no time for this
discussion."
dialogues.text:
"But since we're in a hurry, there's no time for this
discussion."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうかなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I don't agree with that..."
dialogues.text: "I don't agree with that..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「君が貞操を守りたいのならば、仕方ない……
　俺が熱い口付けを」
dialogues.en: "If you want to save your kiss, then I have to do it......"
dialogues.text: "If you want to save your kiss, then I have to do it......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃっちゃ！　ダメダメ！　それならボク
　がやるよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Wow! No, no! I'll do that."
dialogues.text: "Wow! No, no! I'll do that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふむ……なんだこうだで、君や朝倉妹の反応
　は嬉しそうなのだが」
dialogues.en:
"Hum...... You and Asakura's sister seem so happy when it
comes down to it."
dialogues.text:
"Hum...... You and Asakura's sister seem so happy when it
comes down to it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことないよぉ〜♪　じゃあ、お兄ちゃ
　んにちゅーちゅ──」
dialogues.en: "That's not true. Okay, so here's a kiss..."
dialogues.text: "That's not true. Okay, so here's a kiss..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うるせぇ――って叫ぶのもかったるいわ！！」
dialogues.en: "Shut up!!"
dialogues.text: "Shut up!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃぁ！！」
dialogues.en: "Wow!!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!!"

dialogues.jp:
ごろごろ、と俺が起きた勢いで、布団の上にの
ろうとしていたさくらが転がる。
dialogues.en: Sakura rolled off my bed as I jumped up out of it.
dialogues.text: Sakura rolled off my bed as I jumped up out of it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜、お兄ちゃん。おっはよんよん♪」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan. Good morning!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan. Good morning!"

dialogues.jp:
そのまま後転して、さくらがニパニパと手を開
いた。
dialogues.en: Sakura rolled backward and opened her hands.
dialogues.text: Sakura rolled backward and opened her hands.

dialogues.jp: 器用すぎるぞ……。
dialogues.en: Nice motor skills......
dialogues.text: Nice motor skills......

dialogues.jp: 「つーか、なんでお前が居るんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふふふ……未知でなくなって少女だけではな
　いぞ」
dialogues.en: "Not only her......"
dialogues.text: "Not only her......"

dialogues.jp:
見たくも聞きたくもなかったが、奴の存在に顔
を向けてしまう。
dialogues.en: I didn't want to look, but I turned towards him anyway.
dialogues.text: I didn't want to look, but I turned towards him anyway.

dialogues.jp:
机の椅子がくるりと回転し、指を組んで、猫を
膝の上にのせた男が姿をあらわす。
dialogues.en:
A man with a cat on his lap, sitting in my desk chair,
showed up.
dialogues.text:
A man with a cat on his lap, sitting in my desk chair,
showed up.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「登場パターン、腹心に裏切られて途中退場し
　そうな悪の大ボス」
dialogues.en: "Do I look like a boss character in a computer game?"
dialogues.text: "Do I look like a boss character in a computer game?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「火星に帰れ」
dialogues.en: "Go back to Mars."
dialogues.text: "Go back to Mars."

dialogues.jp:
枕を投げつけてやろうかとも思ったが、枕が｛けが／穢｝
れるので止めた。
dialogues.en:
I thought about throwing my pillow at him, but he would only
make it dirty, so I decided not to.
dialogues.text:
I thought about throwing my pillow at him, but he would only
make it dirty, so I decided not to.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも、ミッション・コンプリートだね♪」
dialogues.en: "Mission complete!"
dialogues.text: "Mission complete!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「天岩戸作戦は成功したようだな」
dialogues.en: "It worked very well."
dialogues.text: "It worked very well."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、知らんのか？　天岩戸というのは天
　照大神が隠れた岩戸の前でだな――」
dialogues.en: "You know? We had a mission plan and......"
dialogues.text: "You know? We had a mission plan and......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そんな説明しろなんて言ってないって……いっ
　たい本気でなんなんだお前ら｛でこでこ／凸凸｝コンビは」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not asking you about the plan. But why are the big one
and the short one here?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm not asking you about the plan. But why are the big one
and the short one here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でこでこ？」
dialogues.en: "Who's here?"
dialogues.text: "Who's here?"

dialogues.jp: 前髪をかきあげて、さくらがおでこを見上げる。
dialogues.en: She looked around.
dialogues.text: She looked around.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「かまぼこ？」
dialogues.en: "The big one and the short one?"
dialogues.text: "The big one and the short one?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「デコボコじゃなくて、ふたりとも自己主張が
　強すぎるってことだ」
dialogues.en:
"It's not about the size, but both of you have too much
character."
dialogues.text:
"It's not about the size, but both of you have too much
character."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前の解説のほうがどうでもいいがな」
dialogues.en: "Why does it matter?"
dialogues.text: "Why does it matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほっとけ」
dialogues.en: "Shut up."
dialogues.text: "Shut up."

dialogues.jp:
杉並と同じようなため息をついて、陽光降り注
ぐ窓の外を眺める。
dialogues.en: I sighed and looked outside. It looks really nice out today.
dialogues.text: I sighed and looked outside. It looks really nice out today.

dialogues.jp:
なんでこんなハイ・テンションな奴らに付き合っ
て、寝起きのうららかな時間を消費しなくては
ならないんだ……。
dialogues.en:
Why do I have to waste my precious peaceful time with these
crazy people?
dialogues.text:
Why do I have to waste my precious peaceful time with these
crazy people?

dialogues.jp: 「しかし……異常に腹減ったな」
dialogues.en: "I'm so hungry......"
dialogues.text: "I'm so hungry......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それはそうだろう」
dialogues.en: "I'm sure."
dialogues.text: "I'm sure."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだろうそうだろう」
dialogues.en: "I'm soooo sure."
dialogues.text: "I'm soooo sure."

dialogues.jp: さくらが杉並を真似て、腕をくんで頷く。
dialogues.en: Sakura folded her arms and nodded as she imitated Suginami.
dialogues.text: Sakura folded her arms and nodded as she imitated Suginami.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、また丸２日寝てたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You slept two days straight again."
dialogues.text: "You slept two days straight again."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや。冗談でもグッキリカメラでもなく、
　いたってマジ話だ」
dialogues.en: "We're not kidding you. It's for real."
dialogues.text: "We're not kidding you. It's for real."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「またまたボクの不法侵入のおかげで気づけた
　のだ。えっへん！」
dialogues.en: "I found you when I trespassed again."
dialogues.text: "I found you when I trespassed again."

dialogues.jp: ぼやきながら、携帯電話の日付を確かめる。
dialogues.en: "So you know you were trespassing......"
dialogues.text: "So you know you were trespassing......"

dialogues.en: I mumbled and looked at my cell phone.
dialogues.text: I mumbled and looked at my cell phone.

dialogues.en: March 25th.
dialogues.text: March 25th.

dialogues.jp: ……この際、深く考えないことにして……。

「そうだ。俺は確か音夢と一緒に居間で……音
　夢は？　音夢はどうしてる？」
dialogues.en: "Where's Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Where's Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: ふたりが互いに目配せする。
dialogues.en: They looked at each other.
dialogues.text: They looked at each other.

dialogues.jp: 「な――なんだよ一体、っと」
dialogues.en: "What? What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What? What happened?"

dialogues.jp:
慌てて立ち上がろうとしたが、身体が思うよう
に動かなかった。
dialogues.en:
I tried to stand up in a hurry, but I couldn't move my body
well.
dialogues.text:
I tried to stand up in a hurry, but I couldn't move my body
well.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！　ダメだよお兄ちゃん！」
dialogues.en: "Wait! Stop, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Wait! Stop, oniichan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢になにかあった――」
dialogues.en: "What happened to Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "What happened to Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: それでもさくらに近づこうとするが。
dialogues.en: I tried to get closer to Sakura.
dialogues.text: I tried to get closer to Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「鶴から学んだダニエルさんキック！！」
dialogues.en: "Take this!"
dialogues.text: "Take this!"

dialogues.jp: ごすっ――。
dialogues.en: Kick--
dialogues.text: Kick--

dialogues.jp: 腹部に膝をいれられて悶絶する。
dialogues.en: He kicked me in the stomach.
dialogues.text: He kicked me in the stomach.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「半病人が無闇に暴れるんじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Don't struggle when you're half sick."
dialogues.text: "Don't struggle when you're half sick."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お……お前は……その半病人に蹴りくれてる
　んだが」
dialogues.en: "But you kicked that half-sick person......"
dialogues.text: "But you kicked that half-sick person......"

dialogues.jp: だらだら、と脂汗が流れる。
dialogues.en: I sweated from pain.
dialogues.text: I sweated from pain.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉、今のお前では俺と互角に戦うことも出
　来ないんだぞ！？」
dialogues.en: "You can't even fight me now that you're like that."
dialogues.text: "You can't even fight me now that you're like that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いやさ……だから、俺の不調と蹴りは関係な
　いだろうが」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you think kicking me and being sick are two different
things?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't you think kicking me and being sick are two different
things?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あのね、お兄ちゃん……落ち着いて聞い
　てね」
dialogues.en: "Hey, I want you to listen to me calmly."
dialogues.text: "Hey, I want you to listen to me calmly."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……落ち着いてって、立ち上がることも出来
　ないんだが」
dialogues.en: "I can't even stand up......"
dialogues.text: "I can't even stand up......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃん……ここ２日間入院してて、今は
　隣の部屋で寝てるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Nemu has been hospitalized for the past two days, and she's
sleeping in her room right now."
dialogues.text:
"Nemu has been hospitalized for the past two days, and she's
sleeping in her room right now."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺は朝倉妹を運ぶための荷物要員だったとい
　うわけだ」
dialogues.en: "I was called to carry your sister home from the hospital."
dialogues.text: "I was called to carry your sister home from the hospital."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした朝倉？　顔が青いぞ」
dialogues.en: "What happened? You look pale."
dialogues.text: "What happened? You look pale."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……俺の、せいか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it my fault?"
dialogues.text: "Is it my fault?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「顔が青いのは俺のせいだ」
dialogues.en: "You're pale because of me."
dialogues.text: "You're pale because of me."

dialogues.jp:
あの時、熱のあった音夢と、ソファーで寝てし
まったのがいけなかったのか。
dialogues.en: "No. I'm talking about Nemu......"
dialogues.text: "No. I'm talking about Nemu......"

dialogues.jp:
後で起きるつもりだったのに、目覚めたら、こ
うしてベッドにいたんだから……。
dialogues.en:
Is it because I made love to her even though she wasn't
feeling well?
dialogues.text:
Is it because I made love to her even though she wasn't
feeling well?

dialogues.jp:
さくらに見つけられるまでに、寝入っていたこ
とになる。
dialogues.en:
But she didn't look suspicious when she went back to her
room that night.
dialogues.text:
But she didn't look suspicious when she went back to her
room that night.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前のせいというか、医者も｛さじ／匙｝を投げた感じ
　だ。まったく未知の症状らしい」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know if it's your fault. But even the doctors don't
know what's going on with her."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know if it's your fault. But even the doctors don't
know what's going on with her."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「原因不明でお手上げだって。ヘイ、ジャッ
　ク！　命が惜しかったら金を出せ！」
dialogues.en:
"They can't do anything because they don't know what's wrong
with her." Sakura lifted her arms in the air.
dialogues.text:
"They can't do anything because they don't know what's wrong
with her." Sakura lifted her arms in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お手上げというより、それはホールドアップ
　だな」
dialogues.en: "That's more like a hold up."
dialogues.text: "That's more like a hold up."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにょ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ちなみに、今のご時世、そのネタを飛行機内
　でやると捕まるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"If you do that in an airplane, they'll arrest you for sure
these days."
dialogues.text:
"If you do that in an airplane, they'll arrest you for sure
these days."

dialogues.jp:
相性が悪いのか、さくらがどんどん猫化してい
く。
dialogues.en:
They might not get along too well but Sakura's acting more
and more like a cat around Suginami.
dialogues.text:
They might not get along too well but Sakura's acting more
and more like a cat around Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
「って、お前らと一緒にいるとシリアスになれ
　んな」
dialogues.en: "I can't think straight with you guys around me."
dialogues.text: "I can't think straight with you guys around me."

dialogues.jp:
腹を押さえたまま立ち上がり、思わずうめいて
しまう。
dialogues.en: I moaned pressing my stomach as I stood up.
dialogues.text: I moaned pressing my stomach as I stood up.

dialogues.jp: ありがたいというのか、なんなのか。
dialogues.en: Is that a good thing or what?
dialogues.text: Is that a good thing or what?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「シリアス？　似合わんからやめろやめろ」
dialogues.en: "You can't think straight either way."
dialogues.text: "You can't think straight either way."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよお兄ちゃん。お兄ちゃんが悩んだっ
　て、どうせ何も思いつかないから」
dialogues.en:
"That's right. You shouldn't think about it, nothing will
come out of it anyways."
dialogues.text:
"That's right. You shouldn't think about it, nothing will
come out of it anyways."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うぅぅ」
今度は胸が痛くなってきやがった。
dialogues.en: Now I have a chest pain.
dialogues.text: Now I have a chest pain.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、音夢の不調が原因不明？」
dialogues.en: "How can they not know what's wrong with Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "How can they not know what's wrong with Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: しゃがみこんだまま、杉並を見上げる。
dialogues.en: I looked up Suginami as I crouched.
dialogues.text: I looked up Suginami as I crouched.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前も知ってるだろう。朝倉妹の不調に原因
　が見当たらないことは」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you know that they can't find anything wrong with
your sister?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't you know that they can't find anything wrong with
your sister?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それはそうだけど……２日間も寝込む病気っ
　てなんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, but she's been getting worse lately. What's causing
her to sleep two days straight?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, but she's been getting worse lately. What's causing
her to sleep two days straight?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そういう遺伝子の病気はあるけどね。でも、
　そういうのじゃないと思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"There's a disease like that caused by genetic problems. But
it doesn't apply to her."
dialogues.text:
"There's a disease like that caused by genetic problems. But
it doesn't apply to her."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、肉体的に原因が見つからないんで、心
　因性のものかって話はあるけどな」
dialogues.en:
"They say it could be psychological, since they can't find
anything physically wrong."
dialogues.text:
"They say it could be psychological, since they can't find
anything physically wrong."

dialogues.jp: ハンマーで頭を叩かれたような衝撃だった。
dialogues.en: It felt like someone had split my head open with a hammer.
dialogues.text: It felt like someone had split my head open with a hammer.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の病気が心のほうからくる問題だったのか？
dialogues.en: Did her sickness come from her mind?
dialogues.text: Did her sickness come from her mind?

dialogues.jp: ぐらぐら、と身体が揺れる。
dialogues.en: My body shook.
dialogues.text: My body shook.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが頭を揺らしているだけだった。
dialogues.en: It was because Sakura was shaking my body.
dialogues.text: It was because Sakura was shaking my body.

dialogues.jp: 「……心因性ね」
dialogues.en: "Psychological......"
dialogues.text: "Psychological......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あのねお兄ちゃん……ボクね、音夢ちゃ
　んとお兄ちゃんは――！」
dialogues.en: "You know, I think you and Nemu-chan are........."
dialogues.text: "You know, I think you and Nemu-chan are........."

dialogues.jp:
なにかを叫ぼうとしたさくらの口を、杉並がふ
さいだ。
dialogues.en:
Suginami covered her mouth as she was trying to say
something.
dialogues.text:
Suginami covered her mouth as she was trying to say
something.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そっとしておいてやるから、あんまり深く考
　えずに自分のすることを考えてみろよ」
dialogues.en: "We'll leave you alone, so think about what you need to do."
dialogues.text: "We'll leave you alone, so think about what you need to do."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: じたばた、と視界の端でさくらがもがいている。
dialogues.en: Sakura was struggling at the corner of my sight.
dialogues.text: Sakura was struggling at the corner of my sight.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前が朝倉妹に迷惑かけてるんだと思ってる
　んなら、ただの思い込みだ」
dialogues.en: "You're wrong if you think you're making trouble for Nemu."
dialogues.text: "You're wrong if you think you're making trouble for Nemu."

dialogues.jp: くっ、と杉並の腕がさくらの首にはまる。
dialogues.en: Suginami put his arm around Sakura's neck.
dialogues.text: Suginami put his arm around Sakura's neck.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「逆だ逆……もっとかまってやらんと、寂しが
　りやの兎は、夜毎、枕を濡らすことになるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"It's the opposite of the opposite. The lonely rabbit wets
her pillow crying if you don't take care of her."
dialogues.text:
"It's the opposite of the opposite. The lonely rabbit wets
her pillow crying if you don't take care of her."

dialogues.jp: そして、くっ、と腕がぶれた。
dialogues.en: And his arm moved.
dialogues.text: And his arm moved.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゅ！」
dialogues.en: "Wow!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よく言うだろう？　病は奇なりと！」
dialogues.en: "You know what they say? Fancy may kill or cure!"
dialogues.text: "You know what they say? Fancy may kill or cure!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらの足が浮かんで、かく、と身体が脱力し
た。
dialogues.en: He lifted up Sakura and she lost consciousness.
dialogues.text: He lifted up Sakura and she lost consciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゅう……」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「｛たと／喩｝えが微妙におかしいぞお前……」
dialogues.en: "I don't think it's the right way to say it but......"
dialogues.text: "I don't think it's the right way to say it but......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、分かったよ……面倒だが、なるべくあ
　いつの側にいるよ」
dialogues.en: "But I'll be close to her as much as I can."
dialogues.text: "But I'll be close to her as much as I can."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうしてくれると俺も助かる。それと、眠い
　のでそろそろ帰らせてもらう」
dialogues.en:
"That would be great. I should be going because I'm really
sleepy."
dialogues.text:
"That would be great. I should be going because I'm really
sleepy."

dialogues.jp:
さくらのうなじを子猫のように持って、杉並が
扉のノブに手をかける。
dialogues.en:
Suginami reached for the door knob, holding Sakura by the
neck like a kitten.
dialogues.text:
Suginami reached for the door knob, holding Sakura by the
neck like a kitten.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう」
dialogues.en: "By the way......"
dialogues.text: "By the way......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや……通知が来る前に、お前には伝えてお
　いたほうがいいだろうな」
dialogues.en: "I think I should let you know before you get the notice."
dialogues.text: "I think I should let you know before you get the notice."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹……本校への進学な、ドクターストッ
　プだ」
dialogues.en: "Your sister can't go back to school. It's doctor's orders."
dialogues.text: "Your sister can't go back to school. It's doctor's orders."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあな」
dialogues.en: "See ya."
dialogues.text: "See ya."

dialogues.jp: ――パタン
dialogues.en: The door closed.
dialogues.text: The door closed.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の進学の話◆
dialogues.en: ◆Will Nemu be able to go to highschool?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Will Nemu be able to go to highschool?◆

dialogues.jp:
杉並とさくらに起こされた俺は、ふたりが俺と
音夢を助けてくれたことを知る。
dialogues.en:
Suginami and Sakura woke me up, and I found out that they've
helped us.
dialogues.text:
Suginami and Sakura woke me up, and I found out that they've
helped us.

dialogues.jp:
そして、音夢の病状が思ったよりも悪いことと、
進学の道が完全に閉ざされたことを――。
dialogues.en:
And they told me that Nemu's condition is getting worse than
expected and she can't go back to school......
dialogues.text:
And they told me that Nemu's condition is getting worse than
expected and she can't go back to school......
